items.title: Western Heat Premiums Melt as Natural Gas Cash Retreats

items.title: Is the Henry Hub Winter Strip Slump New? Not for 3 Years
items.summary: Natural gas winter forward prices sank to their lowest of the year on Wednesday as a historically strong El Niño and stout supply continued to pressure the 2026/27 strip, deepening a monthslong slide that mirrors the past three years.

items.title: Natural Gas Futures Climb Off the Mat After Storage Punch
items.summary: Natural gas futures rebounded from early losses Thursday despite fading weather-driven demand and a larger-than-expected storage build, with lower production and strong LNG feedgas providing support.

items.title: Western Canadian Natural Gas Forward Prices Sink Below $1 Into 2027
items.summary: Western Canadian natural gas forward curves are pointing to persistent supply pressure through 2027, with some of the region’s major hubs falling below $1/MMBtu even after more LNG exports are expected to add greater demand.

items.title: Storage Print Tops Estimates, Keeps Pressure on Natural Gas Futures
items.summary: New York Mercantile Exchange natural gas futures limped into midday trading after the latest government inventory data reflected supply/demand tightening but exceeded market expectations.

items.title: Natural Gas Storage Deficits Deepen Despite Bearish Miss
items.summary: The US Energy Information Administration (EIA) on Thursday reported a 40 Bcf net injection of natural gas into underground storage during the week ended Sept. 4, a lean figure versus historical norms that nonetheless exceeded consensus forecasts.

items.title: EIA Outlook Calls for Natural Gas to Sustain Leading Share of US Electricity Generation
items.summary: Natural gas should comfortably maintain its outsized slice of the overall US electricity generation pie, owing to supply abundance and reliability, the latest federal forecasts show.

items.title: Atlantic Hurricane Drought Clears Path for US LNG Export Growth

items.title: Argent LNG Looks to Albania as Adriatic Gateway for US Supply
items.summary: Argent LNG is extending its strategy into the Adriatic with tentative partnership on a 5 Mt/y LNG import terminal in Albania that could provide another route for US supply into the Western Balkans.

items.title: Natural Gas Futures Slip Below $2.80 Ahead of EIA Storage Report
items.summary: With attention focused on the latest government storage data scheduled for release later this morning, natural gas futures edged lower to start the trading session.

items.summary: The U.S. Energy Information Administration has raised its forecast for U.S. crude oil production in 2027 to 14.3 million barrels per day, up from 14.2 million bpd in August and 14.0 million bpd in July. For 2026, EIA is still calling for 13.8 million
